The recorded Countermove run in the repository covers S1 to S4 (weETH and cbBTC markets). There is no S5 journal yet, so this replay cannot be shown without inventing data. Recording it with scripts/countermove_fork_demo.py on the PT-reUSD market would enable this slot.
HISTORICAL DATA · MODEL CHECK USDC depeg after SVB · cutoff 11 March 2023

This event really happened. FAULTLINE uses it to check that its risk priors are built only from data available before the cutoff. USDC closed at $0.961 on 12 March 2023; the intraday low is not in the dataset. FAULTLINE did not exist at the time and protected nothing.

data/fixtures/replay_h04.json · tests/test_hardening.py
COUNTERMOVE · ARM PROTECTION Decide the defense before the crisis A policy says when FAULTLINE may act, which moves it may make, and how much it may spend. A RescueVault you own holds the reserve and refuses anything outside the policy. Connecting a wallet never grants that permission.
NOT APPLICABLE TO {{ arm.posName }} Protection defends a loan. This position has no debt, so there is nothing to repay and no liquidation to avoid.

For deposits and unlevered positions, FAULTLINE's answer is STAY, EXIT or REVIEW. To configure a policy, use a borrow position.
